verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a search-results API, not an agent or host application that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows SerpApi only in the MCP server role: its MCP integration lets agents use SerpApi as a search tool. That is the separate server story and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
